messages:
Nina (docs): Quick bug: the API reference for /v1/generate still shows a single JSON body example when stream=true. Users keep parsing the full response and failing when they hit SSE.

Omar (eng-runtime): Right — runtime sends text/event-stream with event: partial / event: done. Payloads are JSON in data: lines with fields text and delta.

Lee (eng-ml): Can we publish a canonical minimal SSE example and a stream=false JSON example side-by-side? That helped last time.

Priya (product): Also add a one-line migration note so integrators know how to opt-out (stream=false) if they can't handle SSE.

Nina (docs): I'll open a tiny PR to swap the wrong example, add a curl SSE snippet, a small SSE sample block, Node/Python micro-snippets, and the migration blurb. Keeping examples tiny.

doc-bot: PR created by Nina (docs) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1901

Omar (eng-runtime): Assign me for review. I'll add a test to assert event names and that data contains text/delta.

Nina (docs): Draft snippets below for copy-paste:

Nina (docs): ```bash
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
```

Nina (docs): ```
event: partial
data: {"text":"H","delta":"H"}

event: partial
data: {"text":"i","delta":"i"}

event: done
data: {"text":"Hi","delta":"","final":true}
```

Nina (docs): ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> single JSON response with text field
```

Lee (eng-ml): Looks good. Please add a brief troubleshooting note about common SSE parsing mistakes (not trimming 'data:' prefix).

Omar (eng-runtime): Reviewing PR now. Minor nit on spacing in the SSE block otherwise LGTM.

Nina (docs): Fixed spacing, merging after Omar approves. Will ping SDK owners to update language readmes.

Priya (product): Thanks — much clearer for customers. :tada:
